verdicts.question: Is the cable routing in the site photos continuous and consistent across the documented run — from rooftop panels to DCDB to inverter to ACDB to solar meter to main panel — with no orphan ends, no unexplained mid-run size changes, and visible conduit / cable-tie / clipping where the run is exposed?

verdicts.photo_observation: Tracing the color-coded legend (page 4) across pages 11-21: the red DC cable path runs from the proposed PV module area (pages 11-12) toward the 'Inverter and accessories' room (page 13, red arrow arriving at the label box). The purple AC cable then continues from the same room, along an exterior wall, down the building facade via clipped white PVC conduit (pages 13-15), through a window opening, and terminates at the labeled Main meter/Solar meter panel (pages 15-16). Separately, the green AC earthing cable and orange LA cable run from the roof (pages 17-19) down the facade (pages 19-21) to the marked DC/AC/LA earth pits in the ground-floor side yard (page 21). All colored lines match the legend consistently, conduit and clipping are visible at each exposed run, and each photo's arrow direction picks up where the previous photo's arrow left off.
verdicts.rationale: The cable paths are traceable end-to-end across consecutive captioned photos with consistent color-coding and visible conduit/clipping, and no orphan ends or unexplained routing gaps were observed; confidence is medium rather than high because the run is documented across many separate photos rather than one continuous shot, so some inferred continuity between frames is required.
